name: Small Town Big Dreams
source:
Play as Emory, a photographer fresh out of university with big dreams of having his own gallery. Join him as he moves to the small town of Maple Hill, meets the very queer populace, forms friendships, nurtures old ones and starts his first  full time job!

[From [url=https://achillesdesign.itch.io/small-town-big-dreams]itch.io[/url]]
